decisions.reason: At message 158, changing prize amounts and draw frequencies does not necessarily remove or modify Aave yield generation; the later message about Aave cannot be used for this source-time audit.
The source changes prize distribution cadence while stating that the same net amount remains awarded; it does not change the per-sale allocation or pool recipients.
The source changes winner counts, prize amounts, and sales triggers but does not decide whether prizes use automatic delivery or a claim flow.
The $5 code-based referral commission, its recipient, and its automatic payment behavior remain unchanged.
The source does not alter the random allocation of the $5 commission when a mint has no referral code.
The new prize cadence does not change the flat secondary royalty, founder allocation, pool funding by royalties, or the rule that secondary sales do not generate referral tickets.
Changing prize schedules does not alter how the book, referral code, badges, or active and expired tickets behave when an NFT transfers.
The source does not change the NFT mint number's role, permanence, or display locations as a referral code.
The prize-schedule adjustment does not modify badge triggers, thresholds, destination, or current function.
